title: Trace table template
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Think like a computer: algorithms
source: Seeded from computing/y7 lesson 7 (Trace table template (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 7: Sequence, selection and iteration. To understand how sequence, selection and iteration are the building blocks of every algorithm

questions.q: Label each line: 'Fill kettle. IF kettle is full THEN switch on. Repeat: check if boiled.'
questions.model: Teacher labels line by line: one action in order = sequence; IF = selection; repeat = iteration.

questions.q: What does this output? FOR i = 1 TO 3: OUTPUT i * 2
Write an IF... THEN... ELSE for a prayer reminder: if time is 13:00 or later and Dhuhr not prayed, remind.
questions.a: IF time >= 13:00 AND prayed = false THEN OUTPUT 'Pray Dhuhr' ELSE OUTPUT 'Well done'.

questions.q: Core: Write an algorithm for a 'guess the number' game that uses sequence, selection and iteration. Label each.
questions.a: Set secret; REPEAT input guess; IF guess = secret THEN 'Correct' ELSE IF guess < secret 'Higher' ELSE 'Lower'; UNTIL guess = secret.
questions.model: Teacher writes the first two lines: 'secret = 7' (sequence) and 'REPEAT' (iteration), naming each.

questions.q: Extend: Trace: total = 0; FOR i = 2 TO 8 STEP 2: total = total + i. Output?
Stretch: Explain the difference between a FOR loop and a WHILE loop, with an example of each.
questions.a: FOR repeats a set number of times (count to 10); WHILE repeats until a condition changes (while not boiled).

questions.q: IF... THEN... ELSE is... A) sequence B) selection C) iteration
Big question: name the three building blocks of every algorithm.
